changes.evidence: Runaways S3 episode 9 ('The Broken Circle'): after Geoffrey breaks free of Morgan's spell he reassembles PRIDE to save Molly from Morgan's coven, and Leslie answers the call and rejoins PRIDE, fighting Morgan with them. She had distanced herself from PRIDE and the church in season 2 (her 'left' Runaways S1–S2 stays). Her rejoining PRIDE has no stage.

Runaways S3 episode 6: Dale goes back to Los Angeles and lives in a tent on the Church of Gibborim's compound as one of its parishioners (the PRIDE page says he 'rejoined' the church and spent months there). In S3 episode 9 ('The Broken Circle') Dale, with Stacey now free of the Magistrate's Wife, answers Geoffrey's call and rejoins the reassembled PRIDE to save Molly. The church stage is Dale's alone (this file holds both Yorkes); the PRIDE stage in S3 applies to both.

Runaways S1 episode 5 ('Kingdom') flashback: in 1999 Geoffrey is in Los Angeles Penitentiary with Darius Davis for gang activity (the shooting of Osiris) and gets Darius to take the blame so he can go free; in 'Old School' he recalls the gang's 'code... a brotherhood'. A past group the screen shows, left out. 'The Crips' is the dataset's existing name for Darius's gang (T:pr-st-darius-davis).

Agent Carter episode 12 (S2 episode 4, 'Smoke & Mirrors') flashback: in 1940 Peggy works as a codebreaker at Bletchley Park (engaged to Fred Wells, who works in her department) before she leaves it for the SOE. A past group the screen shows (her own step names it), left out; the record starts at SOE.

Cloak & Dagger episode 5 ('Princeton Offense'): O'Reilly tells of her past as a detective in Harlem ('Drug busts. In Harlem, it was a good way to leap up the food chain'). She transferred to the NOPD from the NYPD (29th Precinct). A past group the screen tells, left out. 'NYPD' is an existing dataset name.

Remove left 'Captain America: Civil War'. Bucky has been in no group since he broke from HYDRA in The Winter Soldier (the 'left' there stays). In Civil War he leaves nothing: in the mid-credits scene T'Challa grants him asylum in Wakanda and he goes back into cryo-sleep there, which is where his Wakanda stage starts, and he is still in Wakanda in Black Panther and Infinity War. The Civil War 'left' is a leftover from when the Independent stage sat on Civil War. Groups unchanged.

owner_calls.question: Runaways S2 finale to S3: Tina (A:pr-st-tina-minoru) is possessed by the Magistrate's Daughter, Stacey (A:pr-st-yorkes) by the Magistrate's Wife and Victor (A:pr-st-victor-stein) by Jonah, the Magistrate, and the Gibborim act through their bodies until Nico frees them in S3. Is this possessed service in a group (Jonah's family, the Gibborim) to record as a stage, or are they only victims of possession? The screen calls them the Gibborim / Jonah's family; the dataset has no group by that name (only 'The Church of Gibborim').
options: Keep: possession by Jonah's family is not service in a group
Add a stage (e.g. 'The Gibborim', Runaways S1–S2) for Tina, Stacey and Victor, ending when they are freed in Runaways S3
owner_calls.evidence: MCU Wiki: Tina 'possessed by the Gibborim Magistrate's Daughter... regained control when Nico got rid of the Gibborim' (S3); Stacey 'possessed by the Magistrate's Wife'; Victor 'entirely possessed by Jonah' then freed in the Dark Dimension. Owner rules count possessed service, but the beings are a family/species, not a named organization.
